## Validation

- [ ] `make lint` (or `CP_CHECK_ALL=1 bash .githooks/pre-commit`)
- [ ] Relevant Go tests added/updated and passing (`make test`)
- [ ] `make test-py` (if `scripts/*.py` changed)
- [ ] `make test-js` (if dashboard JavaScript changed)
- [ ] Documentation updated (`README.md`/`docs/*.md`/`CONTRIBUTING.md`) if behavior, config, or a command changed
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat(alerting): add pager sender`)
- [ ] Screenshots attached (if dashboard behavior changed)
